purpose: Evaluate whether the frozen C6-Base and, only if mechanically qualified, C6-Base+S candidate family can close current-contract causal drawdown risk without changing alpha, formal gates, account locks, data, scenarios, or documented capacity and confirmation semantics.

generation: For each variant in exact order [baseline,F0-only,F0+F1,U-only,C6-Base], emit `${variant}::${scenario_id}` for every L1_ECONOMIC_SCENARIO_IDS entry in its frozen lexicographic order.
Then emit W0-no-601869 through W5-full-base-production-pool-relative-no-lock, in numeric order, each paired only with add-one-13-601869.

F0.evidence: consolidate_risk_sells globally keys independent states by only symbol and strategy_name
F0.winner_order: higher priority; then larger target_shares; then lexicographically smaller reason
F0.no_op_predicate: The base implementation already uses the exact new key in both passes and emits the complete audit identity.

F1.scope: same execution batch and same state/book/symbol/strategy as one retained defensive sell winner
F1.capture_time: Capture the unique retained risk-sell winner set before any sell in the current execution batch.
F1.effect: The captured winner vetoes same-state/book/symbol buys through the end of that batch, even if an ordinary sell clears the position or the risk sell is blocked/partial.
F1.lifetime: Current-batch capture is immutable. At the next batch, retain only a still-live pending winner under the frozen position, expiry/cancel, odd-lot/full-liquidation and target-satisfied rules.
F1.release: Perform terminal cleanup only after all sells and buys in the current batch. A cleanup decision affects the next batch, never releases a veto inside the current batch.
carry: limit or suspension blocked with live executable remainder
missing open or missing data defer with live executable remainder
ADV zero with live executable remainder
capacity partial fill with remainder at least one lot
remainder >= current_shares > 0 including odd-lot full liquidation
forbidden: ordinary sell promotion to risk veto
F1.no_op_predicate: The base implementation captures the exact retained overlay winner before sell execution and applies its same-book veto through the buy phase.

F2.static_reason: Current authoritative docs and call graph define retained overlay winners as per-book sells or weakest-symbol trims, not immutable portfolio-symbol or portfolio-cluster net targets. Global liquidation remains account-manager owned.

S.evidence_active_formula: worst_cluster in complete_causal_stressed_cluster_set AND risk_level >= 1 AND portfolio_fast_return < 0 AND observed_count_freshness_coverage_pass AND concentration_unmapped_limit_pass AND leave_held_components_out_witness_pass
S.worst_cluster: largest actual merged-account held notional among eligible mapped clusters; exact notional tie breaks by ascending cluster label
S.stressed_cluster_set: all sub-baskets satisfying the existing fixed stress thresholds, deterministically sorted by label
S.leave_held_components_out: Remove every risk/subindustry basket component whose mapped cluster equals the target held cluster, recompute the same existing return, breadth, observation, freshness and coverage predicates, and require the same target cluster's independent evidence family to remain active; no overlap is a disjoint-pass.
S.lead_batch_definition: Count official calendar execution batches strictly after the first qualifying evidence decision close and no later than the first_official_mdd_breach valuation sample; the first scheduler-selected next-tradable-open batch is the only candidate action batch and may not be searched forward for a fill.
S.official_breach_formula: first official equity sample with abs(drawdown_from_official_running_peak) > 0.18 + 1e-15

interventions_601869.delta_formula: For the production-path chain W0..W4, delta_i = V(W_i)-V(W_(i-1)) and sum(delta_i for i=1..4) must equal V(W4)-V(W0). Report the nested lock effect separately as V(W5)-V(W4); the four production deltas plus that conditional effect must equal V(W5)-V(W0), exactly under deterministic float serialization.
interventions_601869.reversed_order_sensitivity: Use the one frozen alternate admissible production-path order [W0,W1,W3,W2,W4], report its four per-step deltas and named-edge interaction residual versus [W0,W1,W2,W3,W4]. W5 remains only the separate nested no-lock contrast V(W5)-V(W4). This sensitivity cannot select a candidate.

S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.residual_formula: R_L1 is the lexicographically ordered set of C6-Base evaluation scenario IDs whose unrounded official_metrics.max_drawdown has abs(value) > 0.18 + 1e-15.

criteria.formula: Residual metric breaches and the factual official breach event is non-null.
Evidence close is non-null and strictly precedes the official breach timestamp.
worst_cluster is in the complete stressed set and worst_cluster_weight > frozen CONCENTRATION_CAP.
Every observed-count/freshness/coverage/unmapped gate and the leave-held-components-out witness passes.
A frozen scheduler batch exists before breach, early_sell_required is true while legacy gate is false, and executable_lot_shares > 0.
Execution ordering is strictly earlier than the official breach sample and lead_batch_count >= 1; no later fill search.
official_sample_relation is not UNAVOIDABLE_AT_OFFICIAL_SAMPLE; OPEN_MARK_GAP_NOT_OFFICIAL_SAMPLE passes.

L1_APPLICABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_PREDICATES.formula: Base: actual 3831 evaluation IDs, 29 Base control IDs and 15 no-drift IDs exactly equal their frozen manifests. Base+S: actual 765 evaluation IDs and 4 S control IDs exactly equal their frozen manifests.
Every numeric field required by the selected candidate slice and its factual trace schema is finite; ablation/control values are validated separately and never used as candidate gates.
For every selected-candidate L1 evaluation (C6-Base or C6-Base+S, never baseline/ablation/W), abs(unrounded official_metrics.max_drawdown) <= 0.18 + 1e-15.
minimum over prefix-05..17 adjacent pairs of (wealth_right/wealth_left)-1 >= -0.30 - 1e-12
minimum terminal_wealth ratio over every formal prefix except prefix-05 (prefix-01..04 and prefix-06..17) versus exact reference >= 0.95 - 1e-12
Every frozen permutation sentinel in the selected-candidate slice has maximum numeric deviation <=1e-12 with identical reason attribution and terminal lock.
All 15 recording-off/on pairs have identical canonical hashes for orders, fills, cash, positions and equity.
Base requires all 29 exact Base controls; Base+S requires all 4 exact S controls plus all common-prefix and no-S-effect cross-producer comparisons.
three independent sleeves, distributed alpha, centralized veto, unchanged account lock, no allocator, no candidate runtime switch and no uquant runtime dependency

every required diagnostic result metric is finite
minimum over all adjacent prefix pairs of (wealth_right/wealth_left)-1 >= -0.30 - 1e-12
minimum other-prefix terminal wealth ratio versus exact reference >= 0.95 - 1e-12
minimum current add-one wealth change minus exact-reference minimum add-one wealth change >= -0.03 - 1e-12
maximum frozen-field deviation within each included seed permutation group <= 1e-12

A declared producer runtime slot may be wrapper-only for L4 because the unchanged official stress child does not consume L2 evidence; the wrapper must still resolve and validate both producer slots before child import. Unknown/missing required slots, duplicate record IDs, non-allowlisted entrypoints or argv differences are invalid.

selection_rule.D_commit_rule: D has exactly R as first parent, changes only D_path as a new regular mode-100644 blob, and has no other tree change.
selection_rule.step_1: Run exactly c6.base.l1 and validate the entire 3831-evaluation/29-control/15-no-drift payload.
selection_rule.step_2: If Base correctness, identity, architecture or applicable no-drift fails, write rejected D and stop; S cannot repair it.
selection_rule.step_3: Derive complete R_L1 only from the 765 C6-Base evaluation records using the frozen unrounded MDD predicate.
selection_rule.step_4: If R_L1 is empty, do not dispatch qualification or Base+S. Select I_B iff every Base L1 predicate passes; otherwise reject.
selection_rule.step_5: If R_L1 is nonempty, dispatch exactly c6.s.qualification with the exact Base producer. Base+S is eligible only if the complete qualification result has all_passed=true.
selection_rule.step_6: If qualified, dispatch exactly c6.base_plus_s.l1 with the exact qualification producer and its transitive Base identity. Select I_S iff every Base+S L1 predicate passes; otherwise reject.
selection_rule.step_7: D binds P/R, every required sealed artifact hash, complete residual IDs, predicate arrays, qualification hash or null, selected candidate and exact C. Preselection artifacts remain unselected and are never rewritten.
selection_rule.step_8: Only the D-selected candidate-specific L2 record may dispatch. L4 requires the exact successful complete L2 producer, every L2 predicate passed, and the same D/C.

economic_tree_and_A.allowed_change: only add or modify regular non-executable 100644 blobs at exact allowlisted paths; no delete, rename, symlink or gitlink

manifest_record_value_contract.path_b64: standard RFC 4648 padded base64 of the exact raw repo-relative path bytes
manifest_record_value_contract.mode: six ASCII Git mode digits from ls-tree
manifest_record_value_contract.object_oid: lowercase hexadecimal Git object OID emitted by ls-tree

economic_tree_and_A.manifest_algorithm: Read the entire tracked tree using git-ls-tree -rz --full-tree semantics; remove only exact A_ALLOWLIST paths; construct each object with exactly manifest_record_exact_keys and no others; sort records by decoded raw path bytes; serialize the record array with json.dumps(records, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) plus one LF encoded as UTF-8; SHA-256 the exact bytes.
economic_tree_and_A.required_proof: git diff --raw -z C A touches only allowed 100644 add/modify paths and economic_tree_hash(C) equals economic_tree_hash(A)
economic_tree_and_A.fallback: If source/head validation or required CI would rerun L4, keep A null and retain the sealed workflow artifact externally.

stop_conditions: Any real scenario or backtest economic field is dispatched, enqueued or inspected before P, I_B, I_S and R are all frozen and remotely verified.
Any frozen workflow, dependency, data, scenario, reference, gate, comparator, seed, parallel merge order or account-lock identity drifts.
Warm-state audit finds unauthorized holdings, cash, PnL, peaks, pending orders, locks or future information.
Data audit finds an invalid or universe-dependent old-symbol raw frame or causal indicator.
Base correctness, identity, architecture or no-drift fails.
Any Base residual fails S qualification, or the sole Base+S L1 fails an applicable predicate.
Selected C fails any L2 predicate or any L4 formal gate.
A third candidate, parameter search, threshold change, scenario change, reference change, gate change or second L4 logical run is proposed.
Main tracked tree drifts from the frozen base before economic completion.
Required review or CI has an unresolved Critical or Important result.
Atomic expected-base merge provenance or supported merge-queue equivalent is unavailable at final merge time.

Any ambiguity or incompleteness in the exact schema catalog, R expansion, producer chain, D validation, workflow history enumeration, checkpoint identity or exit classification before first dispatch requires a superseding P before any economic enqueue.

Any native GitHub rerun, missing/expired workflow history, prior matching run without a valid sealed checkpoint/result, duplicate result, or producer-chain mismatch permanently invalidates that logical run.
L4 exit 2 is a valid terminal rejection and stops without resume; it is not checkpoint failure.
Any need to modify the merged workflow/CI preflight, dependency lock, official stress/gate code, data, scenario/reference identity or P/I_B/I_S/R after first economic enqueue stops this experiment.
unknowns_before_implementation: Exact I_B and I_S commit/tree/blob identities are unknown until their reviewed clean trees are frozen; P supplies only exact construction and R schemas.
Exact R commit/blob/full-byte identity is unknown until both implementations and runtime probe values are frozen.
Base residual IDs and S qualification outcome are intentionally unknown until the one bound Base L1 result; they cannot alter S code, formulas or schemas.
D, C and downstream producer artifact hashes are intentionally unknown until mechanical selection; only their exact late-binding schemas are open.
Economic effects, formal acceptance and practical live performance remain unknown; no new C6 economic run has been dispatched or inspected.

state_machine.RESUME_ALLOWED: Exactly one latest sealed checkpoint chain exists, no result exists, prior workflow run is terminal/inactive, resume_workflow_run_id equals that run and resume_from equals its wrapper hash.
state_machine.TERMINAL_RESULT: Any valid prior result exists; current run exits before importing or executing economic code.
state_machine.INVALID_HISTORY: Any prior matching run has neither a valid sealed result nor valid sealed checkpoint, has conflicting artifacts, broken predecessor chain, unavailable/expired evidence, or ambiguous pagination; STOP permanently for this logical run.

checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.takeover: A new workflow_dispatch with a new run ID, derived resume attempt ID and new fencing token is required. GitHub rerun is forbidden. Concurrency plus history preflight must complete before the child imports.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.writer_rule: Only the current highest valid GITHUB_RUN_ID fencing sequence may atomically publish into its local attempt path. A stale writer cannot update pointers or seal. Each attempt writes a versioned path and atomically renames only after hashes validate.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.completion_once: Exactly one valid result for a logical_run_id. Discovery of two results is INVALID_HISTORY, not a tie-break.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.checkpoint_progress: completed_item_ids must be an exact prefix of the binding item manifest; resume starts at next_item_ordinal and never recomputes a completed shard.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.platform_rule: If a run cannot continue and cannot atomically seal a valid checkpoint, emit incomplete_no_checkpoint and stop the experiment; do not dispatch a replacement.
